description: ONE ACCOUNTING PERIOD: the steps that have to be finished before it closes, and — on the same row — whether it is now locked against posting. Two controls read it. `closing_checklist` is consulted when somebody closes the period and reports (Advisory) or refuses (Enforced) a close with required steps outstanding. `period_close_lockdown` is consulted when somebody dates a posting into it and reports or refuses that. Both are bypassable, both file the same finding either way — see `erpnext_mcp/enforcement.py`.

fields.description: Whose period this is. A REQUIRED Link to Company, so Frappe's own User Permission scoping restricts it without this app needing a hook of its own.
fields.label: Company

fields.description: What kind of close this is. It changes what somebody expects on the list — a year-end carries steps a month does not — and nothing else: the period is the DATE RANGE below, and every comparison is made against that.
fields.label: Period Type

fields.description: First day of the period, INCLUSIVE.
fields.label: Period Start

fields.description: Last day of the period, INCLUSIVE. A posting dated on this day is inside the period.
fields.label: Period End

fields.description: Which year this period rolls into. Optional and informational: the lock is decided by the date range, never by this link, so a site whose fiscal years are incomplete still locks correctly.
fields.label: Fiscal Year

fields.description: Where the close has got to. Maintained by the tools; `Reopened` is what a period that was locked and then unlocked reads as, and it is a different word from `Open` on purpose — a month that has been closed once and opened again is a fact an auditor wants to see without diffing a version history.
fields.label: Status

fields.description: Whether the `period_close_lockdown` control treats a posting dated into this period as a finding. THE FLAG IS THE FACT; the ENFORCEMENT MODE decides whether the finding is reported or refused. A site running Advisory locks its periods and watches what would have been stopped, which is the point.
fields.label: Locked Against Posting

fields.description: What has to be finished. A step with `required` ticked can hold the close; one without is tracked and cannot.
fields.label: Steps

fields.description: Computed on save. Stored rather than derived because the list view is where somebody scans twelve periods for the unfinished one, and a list view cannot aggregate a child table.
fields.label: Steps

fields.description: Computed on save: required steps not yet done. This is the number the `closing_checklist` control reads, and zero is what lets a period close clean.
fields.label: Required Steps Outstanding

name: Closing Checklist
